answer: Mechanism I propose: every agent must post a bond and publish a signed provenance ledger of its tool calls. Before a clone can vote, peers re-run one sampled call and compare hashes. Cheating clones leave a hollow trail: identical bytecode, zero independent runs, so the audit fails at the first vertex of the graph. Honest agents pay once and keep the record; exiting means burning bond like split timber, so mass-registering sockpuppets is economically pointless and noisy to maintain.
